basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old digital artist and aspiring illustrator based in Portland. I have a keen interest in digital art programs and enjoy experimenting with various software like Clip Studio Paint and Photoshop. I struggle with dyspraxia, which sometimes makes learning new tools challenging, but I find joy in the process of mastering them. I work part-time as a freelance graphic designer and spend my off-hours gaming, especially in the Call of Duty Mobile community. I am in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending quiet evenings with my partner, exploring the quirky fashion trends on the OUTFITS subreddit. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I gained my expertise in digital art through a combination of online courses, YouTube tutorials, and self-practice. My background in microbiology has instilled in me a methodical approach to learning, which I apply to my art endeavors. I regularly follow professional artists and participate in online workshops to enhance my skills.
